statusLine.command: bash -c 'cols=${COLUMNS:-}; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) read -r _ cols < <(stty size 2>/dev/null </dev/tty) || cols=;; esac; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) cols=120;; esac; export COLUMNS=$(( cols > 4 ? cols - 4 : 1 )); best=; bestk=-1; for d in "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/plugins/cache/*/claude-hud/*/; do v=${d%/}; v=${v##*/}; case "$v" in ""|*[!0-9.]*) continue;; esac; IFS=. read -r a b c _ <<<"$v"; k=$(( ${a:-0}*1000000 + ${b:-0}*1000 + ${c:-0} )); if (( k > bestk )); then bestk=$k; best=$d; fi; done; [ -n "$best" ] || exit 0; bun=$(command -v bun) || bun=$HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/latest/bin/bun; exec "$bun" --env-file /dev/null "${best}src/index.ts"'
